## Behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Evidence

List checks that actually ran, their results, and any gaps. Separate automated tests, simulator results, native desktop tests, and hardware tests. For hardware, record model, firmware, OS, transport and exact scope.

## Sources and rights

Identify new references, dependencies, borrowed code or data and their licenses. Update the source and provenance registers. Do not include purchased kits, samples or personal backups.

## AI assistance

Describe AI assistance when used. Preserve truthful `AI-Model:` commit trailers. A contributor remains responsible for reviewing the change.
